    return [[3 if a == bg and b == bg else 2
             for a, b in zip(r1, r2)]
            for r1, r2 in zip(top, bottom)]

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter

    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid)
               if len(set(row)) == 1 and counts[row[0]] == len(row))
    upper, lower = grid[:sep], grid[sep + 1:]
    shared = set(v for row in upper for v in row) & set(v for row in lower for v in row)
    shared.discard(grid[sep][0])
    background = max(shared, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in upper + lower))
    return [[3 if a == background and b == background else 2
             for a, b in zip(r1, r2)]
            for r1, r2 in zip(upper, lower)]
